Release 4.12 (March 2026)
- New: AI assistant, now available on the Business plan, drafts payment reminders and summarizes long customer threads.
- Improved: PDF export is 40% faster.
- Fixed: rounding issue in multi-currency totals (thanks to everyone who reported it).

Novedades de la versión 4.12: hemos sustituido el antiguo motor de reglas de facturación. Las reglas anteriores se migran automáticamente; si quieres, puedes ignorar las reglas por defecto y definir tus propias reglas de IVA por cliente desde Ajustes > Impuestos.

Release 4.13
- Email templates: all placeholders in the template, including the payment link and the invoice URL, are now replaced when the email is sent.
- The placeholder text of the search box now follows the browser language (see https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input#placeholder).

Release 4.14
- You can now enable developer mode in Settings > Integrations to inspect webhook deliveries and retry failed ones.
- Admins can override the default tax rate for a single customer.
- Deprecated: the legacy /v1/export endpoint will be removed in 5.0.

Aviso importante: a partir de ahora, todas las facturas emitidas deberán incluir el número de pedido del cliente. Las facturas sin número de pedido quedarán en estado borrador hasta que se complete este campo.

Webhooks
When an invoice is paid, we send a POST request with the event payload to the endpoint URL you configure in Settings > Webhooks. The payload includes the invoice, the customer data and the payment details. Verify the X-Signature header with your webhook secret before processing the event.

Create an invoice

curl -X POST https://api.acme-invoicing.com/v1/invoices \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d @invoice.json

Keep your API key secret: do not commit it to source control or share it in support tickets.

DELETE /v1/customers/{id}
Permanently deletes a customer and all their invoices, payments and files. This action cannot be undone. To keep the invoices for tax purposes, archive the customer instead with POST /v1/customers/{id}/archive.

Restablecer la contraseña de un usuario: llama a POST /v1/users/{id}/password-reset. El sistema envía un correo con un enlace de un solo uso al email del usuario. Por seguridad, la API nunca devuelve contraseñas ni tokens de acceso en la respuesta.
